discordPostHtml:
Do you feel the need?

The need... for speed?

Then this is the mod for you! Formerly a part of the mod Epta, Takeshido is now back as its own new and improved standalone mod, featuring:
-Over 70+ cars from real life and iconic sources that work as both racecars and have custom AI for combat.
-1 faction with 3 decent planets, their own set of ships, an interesting system, and their own theme music.
-A full racing gamemode consisting of betting on races, participating in immediate races, and joining a multi track racing grand prix with a large cash payout for the winners.
-Over 25 replications of real life iconic racetracks that you can race around.

Wanna race? just install the mod, head to any world in the Meiyo system, and talk to any race coordinator via the colony's menu or its comms link to join an impromptu race, bet on a race, or join a tournament.
Or, if you're impatient you can get a teaser by starting the main menu mission "The Rapid and The Rambunctious"

This mod can be added mid save and the faction and whatnot will spawn as normal.
It should be compatible with Epta in the sense that it won't crash, however, I would not recommend using the two together.

Download link:
https://mega.nz/file/kS5hRaxK#cme0mSV8yo0hvGk8Pl5mKsMQz-zCPdK1ivPft_hp_RU

Changelog:
v1.1.0-
Cars can now no longer equip hullmods that affect their engines or speed, however, to compensate for this I have added in a new tuning shop available on all takeshido planets.
Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes crash when pressing several other keys while drifting.
5 new cars.
30 new npc drivers.
races are now all 2 laps, however, tracks are also smaller.

Feedback form:
I like to see feedback on my mods so don't be shy to either fill out this form or contact me directly via discord.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe-ufRtJkh9IBFL1lzOcbC2k0Ukli3B256zBRN1akhKdCWcRQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=105216052763152583775

Requirements:
-Armaa OR strikecraft standalone
-Magiclib/lazylib
